Name: DGR 101 - BARON
Information:
**DGR 101 - BARON**

The BARON units were built in secret as a proof of concept, to show that reverse-engineering existing DGR technology was possible. They were created to be used as exosuits to help with secret construction projects, and once the framebilt of High Wave went public with their true intentions, they became a common exosuit worn by members of what would become EXO-SEC.

traits.name: Critical Grip
traits.description: When the DGR hits a single creature with two attacks on the same turn or scores a critical hit against one, it may grapple them immediately. The DGR can grapple creatures up to two size categories larger than it normally could at its size.

traits.name: Lifting Limit
traits.description: The DGR can carry, hold, drag, and push weight equal to four times its usual limit based on its size.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes two Megaton Strike attacks.

actions.name: Megaton Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Point Lock Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The DGR targets a space it can see within 40 feet (120 feet in a zero-gravity environment) which it fires itself toward, and strikes that space to release a shockwave. Each creature within 10 feet of the target space (20 feet in a zero-gravity environment) must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) force damage and 11 (2d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Pummel Grip
bonus_actions.description: The DGR makes a single Megaton Strike attack against a creature it is grappling. When doing so, they make an Athletics check and use it in place of an attack roll result.
